scope.title: 1. Purpose
scope.body: These terms of use govern the use of the SwimAI platform, which connects clients with swim coaches and offers AI-powered coaching tools.

services.title: 2. Services offered
services.p1: SwimAI lets clients search for coaches, book sessions, and access AI coaching (chat, training programs, nutrition guidance, mental preparation) based on the applicable membership terms.
services.p2: SwimAI lets coaches publish a profile, manage their availability and their bookings.

account.title: 3. User account
account.body: The user agrees to provide accurate information when registering and to keep their credentials confidential. Any activity from their account is deemed to be performed by them.

booking.title: 4. Bookings and payments
booking.body: Booking a session with a coach is free. Payment for the session is made directly between the client and the coach, according to the terms agreed between them. SwimAI is not involved in the financial transaction of the session itself.

ai.title: 5. AI services
ai.body: Content generated by SwimAI's AI is provided for informational and indicative purposes only. It does not replace the advice of a healthcare professional, a doctor, or a qualified coach. The user remains solely responsible for any decisions made on the basis of such content.

liability.title: 6. Liability
liability.body: SwimAI strives to ensure the reliability of the information published but cannot guarantee its accuracy, completeness, or timeliness. Use of the platform is at the user's sole responsibility.

dataCollected.title: 2. Data collected
dataCollected.body: SwimAI collects data strictly necessary to provide the service: identification data (name, email), profile data (goals, level, preferences), booking data (slots, coaches), and technical connection data.

purpose.title: 3. Purposes
purpose.body: Data is used for client/coach matching, booking management, service improvement (including AI), and user communication. No data is shared with third parties for commercial purposes.

hosting.title: 4. Data hosting
hosting.body: Data is hosted by Vercel Inc. (440 N Barranca Ave #4138, Covina, CA 91723, United States) and Supabase (database infrastructure). Appropriate technical and organizational measures are in place to protect the data.

rights.title: 5. Your rights
rights.body: In accordance with GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, port, and object to the processing of your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact: [email address].

about.metaDescription: SwimAI was born from a swimmer passion and one conviction: every swimmer deserves quality coaching, accessible anywhere.
about.hero:
Born in the water,
built for you.
about.heroSub: I'm a swimmer. Not a startup founder. A swimmer who was looking for a better way to improve — and couldn't find one.
about.section1Body: Finding a great swimming coach is hard. Generic platforms don't understand swimming's specifics. Certifications aren't verified. And once you find someone, there are no tools to track progress, analyse technique, or plan sessions intelligently.
about.section2Body: SwimAI connects passionate swimmers with certified coaches — and adds a layer of artificial intelligence to personalise every journey. AI analyses, the human coach guides, the swimmer progresses. Three actors, one goal: go further in the water.
about.section3Body: For the adult who wants to learn to swim without judgment. For the triathlete who wants to optimise their crawl. For the competitive swimmer chasing those last seconds. For the aquaphobe who finally wants to make peace with water. SwimAI is built for everyone fascinated by swimming — whatever their level.
about.comingSoonBody: We're finalising the last details. Sign up to be among the first to access SwimAI.
about.value1Body: AI amplifies, it doesn't replace. Every SwimAI coach is certified and verified.
about.value2Body: No vague promises. Real metrics, documented sessions, visible results.
about.value3Body: Aquaphobia, disability, first crawl or Olympic preparation — our platform adapts to every swimmer.
